name: VPBank Ho Chi Minh City Music Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A half marathon, 10K, and 5K event held on August 2, 2026 in Thu Thiem, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
ai_summary: The VPBank Ho Chi Minh City Music Half Marathon 2026 takes place on August 2, 2026 at Công viên Sáng tạo (Innovation Park) in An Khánh ward, Thu Thiem, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Organized by Nexus Sport Events and VPBank, the event offers three distances: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with prices ranging from VND 850,000 for the 5K to VND 1,350,000 for the half marathon.

core_facts.venue: Công viên Sáng tạo (Innovation Park), An Khánh ward, Thu Thiem

pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit a range of runners
Backed by an established organizer partnership between Nexus Sport Events and VPBank
Central, notable venue at Công viên Sáng tạo (Innovation Park) in Thu Thiem
cons: Half marathon registration fee of VND 1,350,000 is relatively high compared to the 5K and 10K options
research_highlights: This is the inaugural (first-ever) edition of the event, launched by Nexus Sport Events and VPBank as a combined sport-music-technology 'running music-festival' concept in Ho Chi Minh City.

Race day is Sunday, August 2, 2026, with three distances: 21km (Half Marathon), 10km and 5km; the 21km and 10km start on the iconic Lê Duẩn street and finish at Công viên Sáng Tạo (Creative Park), while the 5km both starts and finishes at Công viên Sáng Tạo.

Race Kit pickup / Expo runs from July 31 to August 2, 2026 on Trần Bạch Đằng street, An Khánh ward, with over 30 exhibitor booths, workshops and a large concert (VPBank Prime's Night) on the night of August 1.

The organizers state a goal of achieving World Athletics Label certification by 2027, and this event sits within Nexus Sport Events' Vietnam Nexus Marathon Series, which also includes Đà Lạt Music Night Run and VPBank Đất Sen Hồng Music Marathon.
Early bird pricing (April 28 - May 28, 2026) was 450,000 VND for 5km, 550,000 VND for 10km and 750,000 VND for 21km bibs.
research_watchouts: Because this is the first-ever edition of the race, there is no prior-year track record on course organization, heat management, or logistics execution to reference.
Runners who registered from July 9, 2026 onward were told their name would not be printed on the BIB or name board due to production deadlines.
Registration/BIB slots for certain promotions (e.g. the 40%-off VPBank customer offer) were capped at limited numbers and could close once quota was reached.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The VPBank Ho Chi Minh City Music Half Marathon 2026 offers three race distances for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to select the option that best suits them.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for this race?
faqs.answer: Registration prices vary by distance: the 21.1km half marathon costs VND 1,350,000, the 10km race costs VND 1,050,000, and the 5km race costs VND 850,000. Prices are listed in Vietnamese dong and registration is currently open for all three distances.

faqs.question: Who organizes the VPBank Ho Chi Minh City Music Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event is organized jointly by Nexus Sport Events and VPBank. Together they are responsible for coordinating this half marathon, 10K, and 5K event, which is scheduled to take place on August 2, 2026 at Công viên Sáng tạo in Thu Thiem, Ho Chi Minh City.

faqs.question: Where and when does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The race is held on August 2, 2026 at Công viên Sáng tạo (Innovation Park), located in An Khánh ward, Thu Thiem, within Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. This venue serves as the starting point for the 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances offered.
